notes.title: The FINAL WEAPON Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]That's right.[/b][/h1]

[h2]After [u]FIVE YEARS[/u] we've updated Super Galaxy Squadron with the most requested update.[/h2]

[i][h3]We've nerfed and improved the final boss fight![/h3][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7690419/9586f758a7c3b1f4afd935eb1bf6b75c62730e84.png[/img]

[h3]ːfuchsiaː The fight has been reworked and the boss now even has a health bar!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7690419/91aee5e889a235cb6a1f3d1f4ee6e41af4df21d0.png[/img]

ːchartreuseː Don't forget SGS is also [b]STEAM DECK VERIFIED[/b] so it'll play great on your Deck or Ally or Ayaneo or whatever handheld PC you might have bought in the time since we last updated this game![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7690419/dc313a037a1790e546a92d7941ee596e6c8c4078.png[/img]

[h3]ːtealː We've also fixed any broken achievements (and added cloud saves) so you should be able to 100% the game now ːsteamhappyː[/h3]

[h3]ːcobaltː We're sorry it's taken us so long to make these updates to the game but...

[b]NEW BLOOD ALWAYS DELIVERS[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/345860/Super_Galaxy_Squadron_EX_Turbo/

[i]Future updates with often requested features like key rebinding and an update to a newer engine that will allow console ports? [b]Hopefully sooner than 5 years from now.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Super Linux Squadron!
notes.content:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/OblongGrossChimpanzee-max-14mb.gif[/img]
Hey everyone! Long time no space! We bring news from the front! :cobalt:

[h1][b]Super Galaxy Squadron EX Turbo is now available for Linux + Steam OS![/b][/h1]

[i]It should work right out of the box[/i] (32bit only for now) so give it a go!

We're just as committed as we've ever been to keeping our games up to date and always making them better so... we'll be porting SGS EX T over to GMS 2 so we can create [b][i]an even better Linux version, Mac version and console versions! That's right - even Nintendo Switch[/i][/b] :chartreuse:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7690419/43106bf4e5d56e34c15a54a71b5adc0b25df6559.jpg[/img]

We're also going to be looking into adding long standing requests such as remappable keys, gameplay + boss tweaks and maybe even some cool progression systems. :fuchsia:

[h1][b]Oh yeah, we've also permanently dropped the price to a firm, flat $10.00[/b][/h1] :D:

Who would think we'd still be updating a fun little game that Nick made for charity back in 2015? :teal:

[i]We did. Because we're New Blood - and we're good like that[/i] :TR:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/345860/Super_Galaxy_Squadron_EX_Turbo/
As always,  you can drop into Discord.gg/NewBlood to chat with us and keep up to date on all the latest - and also check out our brand new developer page to see what's up with [b]ALL[/b] of  our games as well as our latest recommendations.

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/NewBlood

notes.title: Super Galaxy Squadron Goes TURBO!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.giphy.com/xTiN0AX8YuRFSmGYoM.gif[/img]
[b]It's been a long time coming but it's finally here![/b]

[i]Super Galaxy Squadron EX [b]TURBO![/b][/i]   :cobalt::fuchsia::cyan::teal:

The latest, greatest and [b][u]FINAL[/u][/b] edition of [i]Super Galaxy Squadron[/i].

What started as a simple college project by [url=https://twitter.com/nickclinkscales?lang=en]Nick Clinkscales[/url] has turned into what we think is one of the most [b]full featured[/b], [b]fun[/b] and [b]accessible[/b] SHMUPs in the galaxy.
 
[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/UnsungFastIchidna.gif[/img]

So what's new in SGS EX [b]TURBO?![/b]
[list]
    [*][b]SHIPS -[/b] Three new ones (now 17 total) with alt fire modes. 
    [*][b]MODES -[/b] [i]BOSS RUSH[/i] is finally here. Can you defeat ALL of them in record time?
    [*][b]FEATURES -[/b] SLO-MO "Bullet-Hell Time". Slow down time to dodge bullets like Max Payne.
[/list]
We've also added [b]new leaderboards and achievements[/b] - we're good like that.

[img]http://i.giphy.com/xTiN0papp8kv5vCXxS.gif[/img]

Now, if you recall... the sales of the original [i]SGS[/i] benefitted [url=http://childsplaycharity.org/]Child's Play Charity[/url]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/WMQmTyj.jpg[/img]

So how fitting that [i]SGS EX[/i] was just a part of the [b]Humble Freedom Bundle[/b]!
 
We couldn't be more proud to do some good for the galaxy. ːsteamhappyː

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fYVBLJP.png[/img]
[b][i]SGS EX TURBO[/i][/b] will of course be offered as a [b]FREE[/b] upgrade to anyone who already owns the game. Just like EX was a free upgrade. Just like any and all upgrades to New Blood's games will ALWAYS be free. [u]Don't tell our accountant[/u].

We'll be keeping the price of the game at [b]$9.99[/b] through launch week until [b]March 13th[/b] when we'll raise it to [b]$11.99.[/b] This will be the final final final price forever and always. So get in [b]now![/b] 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nngf0dO.jpg[/img]

That being said, both Nick and us here at New Blood want to thank you for taking this journey with us over the last three years and hope we'll see you again SOON™ when the inevitable once again happens... and you're once again called upon to... SAVE THE GALAXY \o/

[img]http://i.imgur.com/I6dODqK.jpg[/img]

:cobalt: :chartreuse: :cyan: :fuchsia: :teal: 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/345860/

notes.title: Super Galaxy Squadron EX Available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/aKNsaNz.jpg[/img]

:teal::fuchsia::cyan::cobalt::chartreuse:

That's right -  [i]Super Galaxy Squadron EX[/i] a/k/a "The People's Shmup" is finally ready for launch. The remastered version of New Blood & Synset's (not a) bullet hell shooter that took everyone by surprise last year has been rebuilt from the ground up with all new art, all new audio, all new modes, but the same SUPER squadron of 14 playable ships. :cobalt:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/z9KiuDs.jpg[/img]

As you may know - proceeds from the original [i]Super Galaxy Squadron[/i] benefited Child's Play Charity and as we get ready to launch [i]Super Galaxy Squadron EX[/i], we are proud to be making a $10,000 donation thanks to everyone who purchased the game last year! You've all made the galaxy a better place for sick kids the world over. \o/ LOOK AT THIS BIG CHECK!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/TXlSr3c.jpg[/img]

Moreover - everyone who already owns [i]Super Galaxy Squadron[/i] on Steam (that's you) will be upgraded to [i]Super Galaxy Squadon EX[/i] for [b]FREE[/b] and have the option to launch either the new or classic version of the game. (And yes both have Steam leaderboards)  :cyan:
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/NFMLWFL.png[/img]

Those who are [b]new[/b] to the Squadron can get SGS: EX for $9.99  - as well as Random Encounter's original soundtrack for just $1.99 extra. That's $12 total for the only shmup on Steam you can probably beat in one sitting as well as the music to go with it. A good deal in any galaxy. :chartreuse:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/JhMfy6n.jpg[/img]

SGS: EX will also be playable at MAGfest 2016 during its launch as part of the (MIVS) Indie Video Game Showcase with game creator Nick Clinkscales and producer Dave Oshry on hand to do battle - in space! :teal:

So tell your friends, tell your mom and tell your friend's mom!

[i]Super Galaxy Squadron EX[/i] is ready for launch - prepare for [b]HYPER OVERDRIVE[/b] :fuchsia:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/345860/

notes.title: SGS EX Beta Update #2! New Levels, Difficulties & Characters!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Uo2ZgqM.jpg[/img

[b]QUE PASO, SPACE COMPADRES.[/b] :teal:

I write to you today all the way from Barcelona, Spain to bring news of the latest Super Galaxy Squadron: EX Beta update!

Senor Clinkscales has been hard at work continuing to add to the greatness that is SGS: EX and I'm here to tell you how.

[b]NEW DIFFICULTIES[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Hn2MEJM.jpg[/img]
That's right - [b]CASUAL, VETERAN and HELL[/b]

That's like Easy, Medium and Hard - all available in Normal or Hardcore modes.

[b]NEW CHARACTER PORTRAITS[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Urgd3EQ.jpg[/img]
Ever wanted your favorite ship to have more CHARACTER and backstory? WELL NOW THEY DO. Nick has started giving each ship its own unique character and backstory + portrait to go with it. NOW FEEL MORE CONNECTED TO YOUR PILOT THAN EVER BEFORE.

Especially Jelly Roll. Jelly Roll is a complex and complicated soul.

[b]AND NEW LEVELS[/b]

Well, one new level. LEVEL 2!

Go test it out by opting into the BETA branch in your game properites and PLEASE continue to give us feedback as we continue to turn Super Galaxy Squadron into SUPER GALAXY SQUADRON: EX

[img]http://i.imgur.com/gMm5N05.png[/img]

The EX stands for... EXTRA BUENO

Chur. :cobalt:

notes.title: Super Galaxy Squadron v1.05 Is Live!
notes.content:
We've been hard at work since last weekend tweaking, fixing, changing and adding features to SGS thanks to your feedback and are happy to push v1.0.5 LIVE. ːtealː

Here's the changelog:

- Steam achievements, trading cards and leaderboards are now all good to go!
- Full controller support is now FULL (D-pads work!) and arcade sticks are also now supported
- Addressed soft lock from getting killed by Great Rift's laser
- Added a game over screen to Endless Mode, along with rankings. Don't get an F. F is bad.
- Added more achievements cuz why not
- Fixed Arcade Mode Steam leaderboard
- Added a Steam leaderboard for Endless Mode
- Made Max Bonuses easier to get against Great Rift and Iron Helix
- Increased spawn rate of upgrades
- Increased base rate of fire of most ships
- Increased power of Big Laser
- Doubled invincibility frames after taking damage
- Significantly increased lifetime of upgrades
- Reduced movement speed of upgrades
- Significantly increased lifetime of upgrades dropped from damage
- Reduced movement speed of upgrades dropped from damage

[i]Not bad, eh?[/i]

Here's what's probably coming SOON ːcyanː

Mac/Linux versions
TATE mode 
Steam Cloud Saves
More tweaks to normal/hardcore/endless modes

Thanks to everyone who got Super Galacy Squadron during launch week! Spread the word and let the people know the 15% discount ends [b]TOMORROW![/b] 

ːchartreuseːːfuchsiaːːcobaltː

http://store.steampowered.com/app/345860/

notes.title: Super Galaxy Squadron v1.01 Update is Live!
notes.content:
Everyone who's supported us throughout launch has been awesome and because of their help and some detective work that would put Sherlock Holmes to shame, we've tackled and patched a few things we heard from the people playing. ːfuchsiaː

In version 1.01, we've fixed the most common issue reported by players related to the game hanging or even crashing upon death as well as a minor aiming issue.

That means no more floating in space. How are you supposed to save a galaxy just sitting around in space watching enemies shoot?

Thanks for making this an awesome launch and here's to a great weekend of space shmup hotness! ːtealː
